name: @starter/tool-aws-preflight
description: Read-only AWS sandbox preflight discovery: identity gate, one static allowlist of Get/List/Describe AWS CLI v2 calls, sanitized committable evidence; plus the personal-sandbox account guard (dist/guard-cli.js, scripts/sandbox-guard.sh) that verifies the account with one sts get-caller-identity before each mutating command other scripts run. No mutation capability, no AWS SDK.
